answer: Each agent identity requires a zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM/SGX enclave running approved code, with pulse as the nonce and gale as the hash anchor; bridge verifies the proof and records it in the consensus state tree. Forging identities requires provisioning distinct certified silicon and producing valid enclave measurements. A quadratic bonding curve charges O(N^2) collateral across identities, while equivocation triggers irreversible slashing.
